title: SB 2499 (2023 Regular Session): Statewide Elections Management System; compare identification databases to ensure noncitizens are not registered to vote.
operative_text:

(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.

(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) Sec. 1(1)
(quote) The Statewide Elections Management System shall be compared with the state's identification databases to ensure non-United States citizens are not registered to vote in this state.
(section) Sec. 1(2)
(quote) Any registered voter who receives the notice shall, within thirty (30) days of the receipt of such notice, provide proof of citizenship to the registrar or his or her designee. For purposes of this subsection (2), proof of citizenship includes, but is not limited to: (a) The voter's birth certificate or a legible photocopy of the birth certificate; (b) A United States passport, or a legible photocopy of the pertinent pages of the passport, identifying the voter and showing the passport number;
(section) Sec. 1(3)
(quote) If the registered voter does not provide proof of citizenship within thirty (30) days of the receipt of the notification, the registrar of the county, or his or her designee, where the person registered to vote shall purge the voter from the Statewide Elections Management System.
(section) Brought-forward 23-15-15(1)
(quote) Said registration application shall be compared with the Department of Public Safety driver's license and identification information.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1(4)
(quote) In the event a person is unable to provide any documentation listed in subsection (2) of this section to show proof of citizenship, the person may appeal to the board of election commissioners of the county in which he or she attempted to register and submit additional proof of citizenship in person or in writing.
(other) 23-15-165 conformed
(other) 23-15-15 brought forward (current law: registration application compared with Department of Public Safety data, SAVE inquiry, 30-day proof of citizenship notice)
